evidencePolicy.unresolvedIdentity: Keep candidates with missing context reviewable; publish missing-field guidance and the catalog sources behind a match.
evidencePolicy.sourceDates: Identity-source links and effective dates explain a fact; they do not verify that a business is currently licensed or active.
evidencePolicy.nameProof: Each quoted seller name retains its own confidence; a reliable legal name cannot authenticate additional unquoted trade-name words.
evidencePolicy.descriptorContext: Country hints must bind to the current merchant and exclude buyer, delivery, registration, currency and processor roles. Processor prefixes are retained separately from the seller.
evidencePolicy.literalDescriptorProof: Literal published labels retain punctuation and full provider prefixes separately from cleaned seller names. Generic provider names and lookalike product domains do not establish the billed product.
evidencePolicy.aliasProof: Legal-name fields must match complete entities. Only descriptors may carry a separate observed country tail.
